data.description: A spell storing weapon allows a spellcaster to store a single targeted spell of up to 3rd level (with a casting time of one standard action or less) in the weapon. When the weapon hits a creature and deals damage, the weapon can immediately cast the spell on that creature as a free action if the wielder desires (this discharges the spell from the weapon). The weapon magically imparts to the wielder the name of the spell currently stored within it. Once discharged, another targeted spell of up to 3rd level can be stored in the weapon later. This special ability can be placed only on melee weapons.
data.name: Spell Storing

raw_tokens.value: can store a single targeted spell of up to 3rd level with a casting time of 1 standard action
